topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration introduces interference between A2G and satellite links, reducing capacity. Adaptive modulation and beamforming mitigate this by optimizing data transmission rates and enhancing spatial separation. Tight coordination is required for shared frequencies to minimize interference.
reference_context: L-DACS mitigates saturation in current A2G systems, providing secure and robust data services, with two technology candidates: L-DACS1 and L-DACS2.
